title: refactor(ci): consolidate workflows and standardize lint/test/release automation
author: Asha Patel
description: Consolidate repository CI workflows by introducing reusable workflow templates for Node setup, caching, and common job steps; standardize Node 20 across repos, pin GH Actions to fixed versions, simplify matrices to remove redundant OS/arch permutations, and replace multiple release automation workflows with a single opinionated release pipeline that supports dry-run and canary tags; motivation: reduce CI maintenance burden, speed up pipelines via better caching and smaller matrices, and improve release hygiene; checklist: [x] extract reusable templates, [x] standardize node setup and cache steps, [x] pin action versions, [x] replace per-repo release workflows with single release.yml harness, [x] update docs and CI README, [ ] follow-up: monitor e2e flakiness after merge; related: ENG-2142 (CI consolidation), ENG-2210 (release automation hygiene), SUP-889 (support-facing release fixes)
commits: Replace per-repo lint/test workflows with calls to templates and remove duplicated steps
Add single .github/workflows/release.yml with dry-run and canary support; remove legacy release-* workflows
Pin actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4) and update GH runner usage to ubuntu-22.04 where appropriate
Fix lint step failures by updating eslint config and install step ordering
Address reviewer feedback: split long test job into test:unit and test:integration to improve caching and parallelism
ci_checks: lint: pass (failing initially, fixed by pinning eslint/ordering)
e2e: flaky then pass on rerun
review_comments: Diego Morales: Nice consolidation; please ensure setup-node is pinned to v4 to avoid unexpected behavior from minor changes.
Asha Patel (author): Pinning actions as suggested, updated node-setup template to actions/setup-node@v4 and added explicit node-version matrix entry for Node 20.
Samir Gupta: The monolithic test job made cache misses expensive; can we split unit and integration to improve cache hit rates?
Asha Patel (author): Split test job into test:unit and test:integration and added cache keys scoped to job name.
Claire Thompson: Release workflow looks good; add a dry-run flag and require a manual approval for production tag rollout.
Asha Patel (author): Added dry-run and manual_approval job with documented fallback; updated docs/release-process.md.
Diego Morales: Approving pending a small doc tweak on the CI README (fixed).
release_notes: Consolidated GitHub Actions workflows into shared templates; standardized Node 20 and pinned GH Actions versions; reduced duplicated workflow logic; improved caching and split test jobs to boost cache hit rates and shorten CI time; unified release automation into a single controlled pipeline with dry-run and manual approval for production.
notes_for_ops: Monitor e2e flakiness for two weeks; validate release dry-run telemetry in ops dashboard; ensure runners on ubuntu-22.04 have required packages for new scripts.
post_merge_tasks: (1) Update remaining community repos to call templates, (2) Remove deprecated release-* workflows across subrepos, (3) Observe CI time and cache hit metrics for regressions
risk_summary: Low risk to runtime; CI-only refactor touching release automation so operations should validate the dry-run path before cutting production releases
